title: JEMBEE PLAY NCERT Grade 6 starter catalog
notes: Metadata starter for the NCERT Grade 6 English-medium books listed here: subjects, book titles, chapter titles and original JEMBEE PLAY practice prompts.
All practice prompts prefixed JEMBEE PLAY Practice are independently written; they are not NCERT textbook exercise questions or official answer keys.
No NCERT textbook pages, scans, exercise question text, answer keys or official cover artwork are copied into this dataset.
Book cover SVGs are original JEMBEE PLAY navigation artwork, not official NCERT covers.

NCERT textbooks are copyrighted. JEMBEE PLAY must link to NCERT's official textbook portal only after obtaining any written permission NCERT requires for digital-content packages; do not host or redistribute NCERT PDFs.
Class and edition are dataset metadata encoded in stable IDs/book labels, not extra selection steps in the learner hierarchy.
Every starter question is explicitly tagged sourceType=jembee-practice and questionNumber=JP-1; these are original JEMBEE PLAY prompts, not official textbook exercise questions.
